content: Sibad-wawaad-yoggusadgi Jesús sunmaksad
Bela Roma-dummadga-mani-gaedgi-arbamalad, degi, dulemar-galagwensuli-isgudimaladye-nik-sogmalad Jesús-itogegala ese nonimalad.
Fariseoʼmar, degi, Garda-Narmaked-Dulemar uurmakarmalad, sogdemalad: —We-duledi, dule-isgudimalad-abingaedid, degine, eba-mas-gunbalid-dulebalid.
Geb degi, Jesús burbar emarga sunmakde, sogded:

“Sogmalo, bemar-gwensak sibad-wawaad dulatar-nikasunnad (100), bei wargwen yoggussunnad, sibad-wawaad-wargwen-yoggusad-aminaega, ¿nega-dulesulidganba sibad-wawaad dulabake-gakambe-gakabakebakad (99) obessulir be insae? Eye. Be obesale.
Be amisale, be-gukingi weligwar-ito be mesisaled.
”Ar na negse be nonikile, be-aimarse, degi, be-neg-dikarba-mamaidse be-negse-dagega be gochaled, ega be sogdeled: ‘Anba be wergumarmo, an-sibad-wawaad-ani-yoggusad, an amisad.’

”Degisoggu, an bega sogmar, ar dule-isgudiid-wargwen na e-isguedga bukib binsasar, gwagnonikir, nibneggi bur bule we-werguedba wergumaloed. We-dulabake-gakambe-gakabakebak-nuegandi (99), na e-isguedga bar-bukib-binsaed abesulid.”
Mani-yoggusadgi Jesús sunmaksad
Jesús sogdebar: “Ar ome-wargwen, mani-gwaambe-nikad (10), ei gwagwen yoggusar, ¿gwallu ogassulir be insae? ¿Neg durwinagusar, mani-amiedse imaksasulir be insae? Eye. Mani-amiedse imaksale.
”Ar mani amisale, na e-aimarse gologu, e-neg-dikarba-mamaidse gorbalogu, amarga sogdagodo: ‘Weligwar be anba itomarmo, ani-mani-yoggusad an amisad.’
”An bemarga sogmardo: Deyobmodo, dule-wargwen na e-isgudiidga bukib binsasadba nugunonikir, Bab-Dummad-baliwiturmar, ber weligwar itodamalad.”
Machi-wargwen e-babgi-bangusadgi Jesús sunmaksad
Jesús sogdebar: “Ibagwengine, dule-wargwen masmala warbo nikagusad.
Machi-bipigwad e-babga sokalid: ‘Baba, angadga-ibmar-yoedse-guoedi anga be udage.’ Degine, e-bab ibmar mimidsunnad.
”A-ibagan-ichee-nasad-sorbali, machi-bipigwad bela na ibmar onmaksagu, dikasur yar-baidse nadsunnad. Agine, ibmar-nikadi bela obelosad, galagwensuli gaamakdii gualid.
Na mani-nikadi bela obelosgu, a-yargi ukud-dummad nagunonikid. Degisoggu, nue wilearsunnad.
”Degi, machigwa a-yargi dule-wargwense arbaed-aminade gusad. Dule na e-nainuse ega sin-akwega machigwa-barmissunnad.
Dule machigwaga masgunned uksursoggu, na bela-bela ukudmaada-itogedbali, sin-mas-gunnedi gunbiguali gussunnad.
”Degi, machigwa mag neg-itoargu sogded: ‘Ibibayobi an-bab-neggi an-babga-arbamaladdi masgunned bukidar-nika an insado. Andi wegi ukudba burgwedanikid.
Gannar an an-babse naergebodo, an ega sogdapoed: Baba, Bab-Dummadgi an dummad-nosad, degine, begi an dummad-nosbalid.
Degisoggu, bar be-machiga an guedsulid. Bega arbaed-wargwenga be an-imaksun.’

Machigwa gwichibin imaksad, na e-babse arsunnad. ”Machigwa amba dikasur daniki, bato e-bab daksabinned, na wile e-machi-dakdedbali, e-machi-abin abarmakded, ise-angaagwar e-machi-gadapid, degi, ei wagar udsunnad.
”E-machi na e-babga sogded: ‘Baba, Bab-Dummadgi an dummad-nosad, degi, begi an dummad-nosbalid. Degisoggu, bar an be-machiga guedsulid.’
”Ar e-babdi e-maimarga sogded: ‘Bur mola-nued an-machiga be sedamar. Ega mor yomar, degi, argan-yoed ega googi yomarbalo, degine, sapat ega yomarbalo.
Moli-bebe-nikad-e-mimmi-wardummad sedamar, oburgwemar. A, anmar gunnoed, anmar iba-onomarsun.
Ar wede an-machi burgwisanad, emigindi gannar durgunonikid, yoggusanad, emigindi amilenonikid.’ Bela-dulemar, weligwar-ito nadmarsunnad.
”Ar e-machi-dummaddi deun sapurba gudiid. Nonigua, neg-walikgusgu, garmar-gole itoalid, degine, dodonanai dakarbalid.
Machi-dummad ega-arbaed-wargwense gochagu, ese egichialid: ‘¿Igi-neg-gunai?’
Ega-arbaed sogded: ‘Be-urba gannar nonikid, bonisuli nonikid. A-ulale, Be-bab moli-bebe-nikad-e-mimmi-wardummad oburgwisad.’
”Geb degi, machigwa sae-itoded, yapa negyaba dogegualid. Degisoggu, e-bab magaba noarsunnad, negyaba-dogega egi wilenaigusad.
Ar machigwadi e-bab-abin-imakdegu, sogded: ‘Emide birgabargus an bega arbadiid, uayasuli an bega gudisulid. Degite, gwen be angardi an-aimar-abargi iba-onogega sibad-bipisaar be ukdisulid.
Ar we-be-machidi bela omegan-gambasamaladgi bei ibmar bela obelosad. Emide nonigu, agardi moli-bebe-nikad-e-mimmi-wardummad be oburgwisad.’
”Bab, machi-abin sogded: ‘Machi, be anba gudiguad, bela-an-ibmar begadid.
Ar emigindi, anmar werguega, iba-onoged nonikid. Ar we-be-urba burgwisayob gusad. Emigindi, gannar-durgusayob gunonikid. Yoggusanad, emigindi, gannar amilesad. Degisoggu, anmar werguergebed.’ ”
